'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the drawers, the chatbox message "The drawers are locked!  A note on the top of the drawers reads: Wait till I get my hands on Penda, he's nicked the key again!" is displayed, hinting that you must kill [[Penda]] to get the key.
